gaps.sentence: Her ___ (ANALYSE) of the data took three weeks.
gaps.explanation: 'Analysis' is the noun for a detailed examination; an 'analyst' is a person.
'Championship victory' — the title/contest, not the person.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (DEEP) of the lake is unknown.
gaps.explanation: 'Depth' — noun from deep (spelling change: deep → depth).
'Studying management' — the field is called management.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (ARRIVE) of the delegation was delayed by the storm.
They searched the area ___ (SYSTEM) for clues.
The thief was ___ (ARREST) at the border.
His ___ (SHORT) of funds forced him to abandon the trip.
gaps.explanation: 'Shortage of funds' — the noun for an insufficient amount.
